create_scm_scheduler: create an SCMScheduler instance with custom num_train_timesteps and sigma_data parameters
set_scm_timesteps: set timesteps for the SCM scheduler using set_timesteps with num_inference_steps and max_timesteps
run_scm_step: run a single denoising step with the SCM scheduler using model output and current sample
set_scm_begin_index: set the begin index for the SCM scheduler before starting inference
review_scm_scheduler_output: review the SCMSchedulerOutput dataclass containing prev_sample and pred_original_sample tensors
